entries.title: The odometer in one colour set: series colours only on the series bar, everything else ink, with amber only for "at least"

values.label: one set (default): On track keeps the series colours; Distance, Time, Places and When it went wrong are ink with one soft grey (travel, practice) and one faint grey (races that ran to the flag); the other drivers are ink dots, and pointing at a dot or a chip lights that series in its colour. The dashed run past a floor is amber, like the +
series: the same, but the other drivers keep their series colours at rest (the same colours as the On track bar)
before: round 2's six schemes (series, road rust, a rust-to-sand ramp by country, INDY NXT gold and red)

entries.look: Career → the odometer. Count the colours at rest, then point at (or tap) a dot on The other drivers: its series lights in its own colour. Flip to old to compare.

entries.title: His life in weeks in ink on paper: series colour only when you ask for it

values.label: ink (default): every race week a black square. Point at (or tap) a race week, or a series under the grid, and that series' weeks light in its colour while the others go faint
tone: one ink in steps, lightest for his first series and darkest for INDY NXT, so the grid darkens as he climbs; the same lighting on hover
muted: each series in its colour taken halfway to grey; the same lighting on hover
before: round 2, every series in full colour

entries.look: Career → His life in weeks. Point at an INDY NXT week: every INDY NXT week lights gold. Point at GB3 in the key. Flip tone, muted and old.
